title: Late-phase features use proxy dependencies instead of canonical chains
description: Phase 4 features SP-2 through SP-11 all list SP-1 as their sole dependency. The canonical initiative lists SP-31, SP-12, and SP-13-SP-28 as dependencies for each template. While transitively correct, this loses direct dependency information. Since all are seed-data exercises, the build order impact is minimal.
root_cause: Same root cause as lesson 1: dependency chain flattening. In this case, the transitive root (SP-1) is used as a proxy for the actual canonical dependencies. This is less severe because templates are seed data.
recommendation: Same fix as lesson 1: preserve canonical direct dependencies. Even for seed data features, showing the canonical chain helps space_split understand the intended ordering.
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Features by Domain tables
